PROJECT: KoreLumina

CURRENT ISSUE:
Preview/runtime system investigation.

FACTS VERIFIED:
- AI Preview renders correctly.
- Designer workspace blank/white.
- Developer workspace blank/white.

- runtime:file-changed events are reaching the browser.
- SSE endpoint works.
- Runtime starts on port 4201.
- After Stop, preview skeleton appears.
- Runtime stop behavior still under investigation.
- localStorage.getItem("lumina:last-runtime-project") === null
- window.__LUMINA_RUNTIME__ === undefined

FILES UNDER INVESTIGATION:
- apps/lumina-builder/src/components/preview/PreviewFrame.tsx
- apps/lumina-builder/src/hooks/useRuntimeBoot.ts
- apps/lumina-runtime/src/runtime/startProject.ts
- apps/lumina-runtime/src/runtime/registry.ts

LAST CONCLUSION:
Do not investigate image generation, SVG errors, or React warnings.
Focus on:
1. PreviewFrame layout causing right/bottom strip.
2. useRuntimeBoot runtimeUrl lifecycle.
3. Runtime stop/start state synchronization.
4. Why AI Preview works while Designer and Developer previews do not.

NEXT STEP:
Audit PreviewFrame sizing chain and trace runtimeUrl from useRuntimeBoot into PreviewFrame after stop/start.
If you want the strongest continuity, also include the latest findings:

curl -N http://localhost:4100/api/runtime/events confirmed

- DEVICE_WIDTHS
- iframe
- place-items-center
- overflow-auto
- glass-strong container

Known symptom:
Runtime may be running, but PreviewFrame remains on skeleton and does not rebind.
That will give the new chat enough context to continue without redoing the investigation from scratch.
